name: ACOUSLIC-AI Challenge
description: A challenge focused on automated fetal abdominal circumference measurement from blind-sweep ultrasound data collected in low-resource settings.
reputation: A niche but relevant medical-imaging challenge with interest from researchers working on low-resource ultrasound and fetal biometry measurement.
notes: Non-LLM medical imaging benchmark; data are domain-specific (ultrasound) and may be limited in size and heterogeneous; privacy and annotation variability are important caveats; performance is typically reported in millimeter error or percent within clinically acceptable error bounds.
